entities.name: Wildfire
entities.description: Plane of flame and lava, home of djinn, efreet and goblins, ruled by Emberwilde Caliph Jan bin Jan and the Emberwilde Order.

entities.name: Emberwilde Order
entities.description: Group of Suq'Ata mages who pledged allegiance to Wildfire.

entities.name: Wildfire Efreeti
entities.description: Main servants of the Emberwilde Djinn, used as emissaries to Suq'Ata.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: Dominarian land with which Wildfire trades.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane linked to Wildfire by portals.

events.summary: Beings of Wildfire teach Dominarian goblins to harness fire magic, knowing they could not master it.
events.quote: responsible for teaching the goblins of Dominaria how to harness fire magic

relations.quote: ruled by the Emberwilde Caliph Jan bin Jan

relations.note: Main servants of the Emberwilde Djinn.
relations.quote: The Wildfire Efreeti are the main servants of the Emberwilde Djinn
